Creation of a Task Force on Hazardous Wastes. There is hereby
created the Philippine Task Force on Hazardous Wastes in Fonner U. S. Military
Installations, hereinafter referred to as the Philippine Task Force (PTF), under the joint
administrative and teclmical supervision of the Department of Foreign Affairs (DF A) and
the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR).

Funding.
The funds for the initial year of operations of the PTF,
in the amount of fifty million pesos (P50M), shall be sourced from the President's
Contingent Fund or Social Fund. Thereafter, the Task Force shall submit an
annual budget to be incorporated into the annual budgetary allotment of the DF A,
providing for, among other things: consultancy fees to experts; honoraria for
members and other resource persons; and, participation in specialized training
courses, subject to applicable accounting and auditing rules and regulations.
Dlis Order shall take effect immediately.
